question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

Essence or main point of any passage, lecture or book
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gist"** means the essence or main point of any passage, lecture, or book. (सार)

 
 
• **Example: **The gist of her argument was that education should be accessible to all.
 
 
 
• **"Gist" **refers to the most important pieces of information about something, or the central idea. (सारांश)
 
 
• **Example: **After reading the entire book, he could easily summarize the gist of the story.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word **'Gist' **is the correct word for the essence or main point of any passage, lecture, or book.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Significance** (महत्व): The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

 
 
• **Example:** The significance of the discovery cannot be underestimated.
 
 
 
• **Meaning** (अर्थ): What is meant by a word, text, concept, or action.
 
 
• **Example: **He was searching for the meaning of the poem.
 
 
 
• **Heart** (हृदय): The central or most important part.
 
 
• **Example:** The heart of the matter is the lack of communication.
